يستصبر (form X)
# يَسْتَصْبِرُ (yastaṣbiru) /jas.tasˤ.bi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# يُسْتَصْبَرُ (yustaṣbaru) /jus.tasˤ.ba.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# يَسْتَصْبِرَ (yastaṣbira) /jas.tasˤ.bi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
